items.title: IVF staff accused of misleading UK parents about sperm and egg donors in northern Cyprus
items.description: Multiple children are feared to have been conceived using sperm and egg donors which were not the ones selected by the parents.

items.title: Tupac murder trial: 'All hell broke loose' night of rapper's shooting, witness says
items.description: After he was shot multiple times, Tupac Shakur refused to cooperate with police and told an officer "we'll take care of it", an officer testified.

items.title: Russia says UK 'will pay' for supplying drones to Ukraine
items.description: An MoD spokesperson responds by saying Britain stands "shoulder to shoulder" with Ukraine.

items.title: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
items.description: German authorities seize dinghies and life jackets during their first raids under a new law that cracks down on smuggling.

items.title: Tributes to actress Hayden Panettiere as coroner finds 'no signs of trauma'
items.description: The US actress, who has died at the age of 36, starred in the TV shows Heroes and Nashville.

items.title: Student killed in Philippines Catholic school shooting
items.description: The alleged shooter, also a student, later took his own life.

items.title: China censors public mourning as it holds former premier's funeral
items.description: While hailing Zhu’s legacy, authorities are wary that the nostalgia could lead to criticisms of Xi’s rule.

items.title: Norway's king admitted to hospital and put on sick leave
items.description: The 89-year-old - one of Europe's longest-serving monarchs - is suffering from a rare blood condition.

items.title: Russia's prominent anti-war politician jailed for 11 years
items.description: Lev Schlosberg is found guilty of "discrediting" Russia's army - a verdict he condemns as punishment for his political position.

items.title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
items.description: Trump's threat on Oman, which has been holding its own talks with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, comes as a 60-day window for peace negotiations expires.

items.title: French PM heckled over wildfire response as blazes continue across Europe
items.description: The prime minister announced on Monday €12m worth of aid to French regions that had been worst affected by the fires.

items.title: Doctors remove 3.1kg stone from man's bladder and claim record
items.description: The bladder stone, which weighs as much as a full-term baby, is believed to be the largest on record.
